reviewed_by: phase 7 — token and pool addresses from infra/alerting/chain-baseline.json, which was read from mainnet and cross-checked in docs/go-no-go-stock-tokens.md
note: An ALLOWLIST. The signer can only build transactions whose every address appears here. An address that is absent is refused — not because a rule forbids it, but because nothing permits it. Adding one is a reviewed, dated commit, never a runtime setting.
routers_note: DELIBERATELY EMPTY until a router is proven to work against this chain's factory. The canonical UniversalRouter address exists on Robinhood Chain and is NOT wired to its factory: it fails with an empty revert (docs/go-no-go-stock-tokens.md, condition 5). An empty list means every swap is refused, which is the correct state for a phase that must not move money. Populating it is phase 8's job, from an address observed working in production.

limits.note: Enforced at the SIGNER, not only at the caller. A limit that lives one layer up is a limit any future caller can forget. These are deliberately far below the $250 minimum funding: this phase signs against empty wallets, and a cap that would allow a real trade has no business existing yet.
